entries.note: The shipper collects an empty container to load it; the cargo is not yet with T.S. Lines.

entries.wording: EMTY CONTAINER TO CFS FOR STUFFING
entries.note: An empty container goes to a freight station to be loaded; the cargo is not yet with T.S. Lines.
The loaded container enters the terminal at the port of loading. After the container moved, a further gate in is transit.
Discharged at the port of discharge or a transshipment port.
The loaded container leaves the terminal to be unloaded at the consignee's.
The unloaded container is returned. Before the container moved, it is an empty container returned unused.
The same return as some depots word it, with a full stop.

entries.wording: EMPTY AVAILABLE GATE IN/CHANGE AVAILABLE/EMPTY AVAILABLE
entries.note: The returned container is made available again. Before the container moved, it is an empty container that was not used.
